title: Lekalo Search Ownership Profile
description: Closed producer snapshot of one admitted artifact-ownership/profile set (dev.lekalo.search-ownership-profile@0.8.0, wire lekalo/search-ownership-profile/v0.8.0). A search input manifest admits this document by kind `ownership-profile`; the runtime decoder enforces exactly this closed grammar member for member (required members, no unknown members at any depth, closed ownership vocabulary, per-member bounds, and the metadata count cross-checks), and additionally refuses profile members that name no real card of the admitted projection and empty member sets. Ownership is a typed property deliberately distinct from Model visibility: `observed` records ownership established by observation, and neither reading ever overrides the other. Documents are exact UTF-8 JSON with no duplicate keys.

project.description: The project this snapshot is scoped to; a foreign project never joins another project's view.

artifactCount.description: Must equal the number of carried artifact rows exactly (a spliced snapshot refuses).

profileCount.description: Must equal the number of carried profile rows exactly.

artifactPath.description: A portable project-relative POSIX path; absolute forms, traversal segments, and dotfiles are refused before any read site is constructible.

ownership.description: The artifact's recorded ownership state; `observed` is ownership established by observation — recorded as its own typed property, never conflated with Model visibility.

id.description: The profile identity; membership is a recorded fact, never a conformance claim from the name.

items.description: A member semantic id; must name a real card of the admitted projection (ghost members refuse at admission).
